title: Maria's School Day
text:
Maria goes to school every day. Her favourite subject is maths. She likes numbers and puzzles. On Tuesday, she has science class. The science teacher shows the students plants under a microscope.

After school, Maria studies English. English is not easy for her, but she practises every day. Her teacher, Mr. Lopez, helps her with new words. Maria wants to speak English well.

questions.text: What does Maria study after school?
How does Maria probably feel about English?
options: She finds it hard but wants to improve
She does not want to learn it

questions.text: Why does the science teacher use a microscope in class?
options: To help the students see small details

vocabulary.definition: a tool that makes very small things look bigger
symbols used for counting and maths
games that you solve by thinking
does an activity again and again to get better

paragraph_translations: María va a la escuela todos los días. Su materia favorita es matemáticas. Le gustan los números y los rompecabezas. El martes tiene clase de ciencias. El profesor de ciencias muestra a los estudiantes plantas bajo un microscopio.
Después de la escuela, María estudia inglés. El inglés no es fácil para ella, pero practica todos los días. Su profesor, el señor López, le ayuda con palabras nuevas. María quiere hablar bien inglés.
